name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd.
about: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited engages in the design and construction of war ships in India. The company offers frigates, anti-submarine warfare corvette, missile corvette, landing ship tank, landing craft utility, survey vessel, fleet replenishment tanker, fast patrol vessel, offshore patrol vessel, inshore patrol vessel, fast attack craft, anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft, electric ferries, ocean going passenger and cargo ferry vessel, hovercraft, and fast interceptor boat products to the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, and other government. It also provides unmanned surface vessels, autonomous underwater vessels, ship-based drones, and green platforms and naval surface guns. verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~21% a year growth, below the ~25% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 30 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 49), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 30 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 41 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 44% a year while PE moved 23 → 30.
